tool_schemas.name: search
tool_schemas.description: Executes a DuckDuckGo search for the provided query, normalizes and logs the request and returned SERP items, and returns up to max_results formatted results in a single (non-paginated) response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is empty/invalid or max_results is not a positive integer, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request-rate or usage limits are exceeded. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when the DuckDuckGo provider fails or times out.

tool_schemas.name: fetch_content
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the given webpage URL, parses and extracts content/metadata, records the fetch attempt for auditing and reuse, and returns the extracted content representation in a single (non-paginated) response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if url is missing, malformed, or uses an unsupported scheme, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if fetch limits are exceeded. Raises NOT_FOUND when the target URL returns 404, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the remote host is unreachable, blocks the request, or returns a non-success response that cannot be retrieved/parsed.

tool_schemas.name: list_search_queries
tool_schemas.description: Lists logged search query executions for the authenticated API client, newest-first. Supports filtering by status/provider and time range. Refuses requests when the calling client is not active or when rate-limit/quota would be exceeded.

status.description: Filter by search query lifecycle status.

created_after.description: Return only search queries created at or after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

created_before.description: Return only search queries created before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get_search_query
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single logged search query execution by id, including its stored metadata (status, latency, result_count, error_message). Refuses access if the query does not belong to the calling API client. Returns NOT_FOUND if no such id exists.

id.description: Primary key of the search_queries row.

include_results.description: When true, include persisted search_results records for this query, ordered by rank.

results_limit.description: Maximum number of search_results to include when include_results is true.

results_cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for search_results when include_results is true.

tool_schemas.name: list_content_fetches
tool_schemas.description: Lists logged content fetch attempts for the authenticated API client, newest-first. Supports filtering by status and url_document_id and time range. Refuses requests when the calling client is not active or when rate-limit/quota would be exceeded.

url_document_id.description: Filter to fetches associated with a specific url_documents record.

created_after.description: Return only fetches created at or after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

created_before.description: Return only fetches created before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get_content_fetch
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single logged content fetch attempt by id, including extracted content fields when available. Refuses access if the fetch does not belong to the calling API client. Returns NOT_FOUND if no such id exists.

id.description: Primary key of the content_fetches row.

tool_schemas.name: get_url_document
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a URL document record by id, including canonical_url and last_fetched_at. Returns NOT_FOUND if no such id exists.

id.description: Primary key of the url_documents row.
